title: Digcount
description: Simple mining counter with ranking display
body:
# Digcount - Mining Counter

A simple plugin to count block breaks per player!

## Features

- **Auto Counting** - Counts every block break
- **Ranking Display** - View all players by mining count
- **Auto Save** - Data saved every 5 minutes
- **Persistent** - Stored in config.yml

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/digcount list` | Show ranking |
| `/digcount save` | Manual save |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default |
|------------|---------|
| `digcount.use` | true |
| `digcount.save` | op |

## Example Output
```
=== 採掘回数ランキング ===
1. Steve: 12345回
2. Alex: 9876回
3. Notch: 5432回
```

## Requirements

- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+
- No dependencies
